allowed_forward_composition: Apply this only as max(existing source-specific global-read completion time, readiness_cycles/sm_clock_hz) on each Oaccum load stage.  Keep the existing FMA stage, because FMA-only was subtracted before publication.
derivation: For each fixed cache tier, grid, repeat count, and trial, use median same-CTA clock64 envelope cycles and compute (LDG128->four-FMA minus matched four-FMA-only)/repeats.  Trials 0-1 define one cache-tier mechanism constant; trial 2 is frozen validation.  CUDA events are validation evidence only; the NCU counter audit is blocked on H200.
forbidden_forward_composition: add readiness cycles to a memory stage
select an Oaccum cache tier from aggregate unrelated traffic

h200_provenance.compiler: CUDA 12.2 nvcc -arch=sm_90 -cudart static (same toolchain as the A800 sm_80 captures)
h200_provenance.vllm_runtime_note: these probes model the FA2 (sm80 source) program unchanged; the H200 vLLM 0.24 deployment runs FA3 for MLA attention

ncu_cache_traffic_audit.alternative: cache-tier separation is checked from the same clock64 data: the dram_cg first-load readiness must exceed the l2_warm_cg first-load readiness (report gate)
ncu_cache_traffic_audit.reason: Nsight Compute (ncu) is not installed on the H200 host (h200-capture-host); the A800 NCU cache-tier traffic audit cannot be re-executed.  It is a validation channel only and never a parameter source.
